terms.gloss: make light of, treat as a trifle
terms.grammar: habeō with in levī, “among light things”
evidence: Tac. H. 2.21; Tac. A. 3.54: in levī habitum, was made little of (Lewis & Short), s.v. levis

sources: Lewis & Short: levis
